svg.title: SNS publish and HTTP endpoint flow
svg.desc: SNS operations publish to topics or SMS, fan out to SQS when policies allow it, and parse HTTP endpoint messages before caller-owned signature verification.
svg.text: SNS publish and HTTP endpoint flow
Publishing is coroutine-first; HTTP endpoint messages still require caller-owned SNS signature verification.
standard and FIFO topics use the same SnsPublishRequest value object
SQS fanout depends on queue policy; SMS uses SNS message attributes
parser validates message shape and safe SigningCertURL, then caller verifies trust
Confirm only after signature, cert chain, and TopicArn checks.
The parser rejects malformed SNS shape, not forged signed messages.
SNS operations publish and confirm; application code still owns endpoint trust and subscription policy decisions.
